title: withania coagulans
intro: Withania coagulans, commonly known as Winter Cherry, is a plant species belonging to the Solanaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and possessing anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Withania coagulans include adaptogenic, antioxidant, and anti-stress effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as withanolides and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Withania coagulans have been found to exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective activities.
